scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 36 boards of three live Deity Online Pericles Culture games armed with culture-seat-monuments (civvis-20261111T000134Z t20-t161, civvis-20261110T234921Z t31-t91 incl. the wars with India, civvis-20261110T232642Z t18-t112), each the run's events.jsonl cut at frame 0 of a turn where a city of ours had no Monument. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --explain --resumed --victory culture built from the branch at 2afe224c74 with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds --with culture-seat-monuments-2 (version two reads v1 || v2, so this plays what arming, which replaces version one, plays). Orders differ on 18/36 boards. Of 64 Monument-less city-boards: in a safe city at war (no at-war major's soldier within six tiles, undamaged) v1 claims or keeps 6 of 31 and v2 22; at peace a near-done Monument (three Online turns or half built) is claimed in 0 of 11 under v1 and 8 under v2; in the 11 threatened city-boards neither claims. Controls in each member: the main binary at 302507a072 on the live genome gives byte-identical payloads to the off arm on 36/36 boards, and with version one removed too both binaries agree on 36/36.
